title: Lecturer on Law
bio: From 2022 to 2025, Carrie F. Ricci served as General Counsel of the U.S. Army, having been nominated by President Biden and confirmed by the U.S. Senate. In this role, she provided strategic legal guidance to Army leadership and led the Army’s legal response to evolving statutory and regulatory frameworks.
